description: How the device's structured data is turned into short English sentences, one fact each, for the NLI rules. Keys are structured-data fields. 'template' takes the value as {value}; a list field produces one sentence per item. 'values' maps fixed values to sentences; other values produce none.

values.local: This device works locally, without an internet connection.
values.cloud: This device needs a cloud service to work.

integration.template: Home Assistant supports this device through the {value} integration.

entities.template: In Home Assistant, this device provides a {value} entity.
